name: openchamber-tts-autoplay
description: Automatic BKG TTS playback for fresh OpenChamber assistant replies.

scripts.check: node --check panel/main.js && node --check background/main.js && node test/verify.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run check && mkdir -p dist && v=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && rm -f dist/openchamber-tts-autoplay-$v.zip dist/openchamber-tts-autoplay-0.1.0.zip && zip -X -q dist/openchamber-tts-autoplay-$v.zip package.json README.md panel/index.html panel/main.js panel/style.css background/index.html background/main.js assets/*.svg && cp dist/openchamber-tts-autoplay-$v.zip dist/openchamber-tts-autoplay-0.1.0.zip
